newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen staying in sideways trend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen staying in sideways trend.

text.p: Polish shares were seen staying in the sideways trend that began in early November as numerous domestic players stayed sidelined before the holiday.
Some analysts said the past two sessions of slow growth and higher turnover signalled that the main market, currently at 13,818.6 points, could test 14,000 points before year-end.

Others said Wednesday's stronger selling after price fixing reflected pessimism after the central bank said rates could rise and that firms' November earnings reports, released by late Wednesday, were not good enough to help buoy the market.
